header.name: CESAR PEREZ
header.role: Full-Stack Developer · UI/UX Architect · Cloud Solutions · Founder @ NovaPage

summary.title: About
summary.intro: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with 4 years of experience building high-impact digital experiences and leading technology modernization on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. I specialize in React (Next.js), TypeScript, Python (FastAPI) and Clean Architecture, and in orchestrating AI agent systems (AutoGen, CrewAI) that solve real business challenges.
summary.background: My background combines the technical rigor of Clean Architecture with the agility to take products from conception to production deployments: deliveries that cut page load times by 1.2 s, sustain 99.9% availability on platforms with 5,000+ daily users, and apply TDD, CI/CD and continuous monitoring. Backed by 38 professional credentials (Microsoft & IBM).
summary.currentRole: As the founder of NovaPage, I serve as a technology partner for companies seeking modernization. I don't just build software; I design the engine of the business: scalable architectures with Python and Next.js, AI agents in production, and enterprise-grade security.
summary.stackFrontend: Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
summary.stackCloud: Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB), Docker, CI/CD
summary.stackAI: AI: Agent orchestration (AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, OpenAI, Gemini)
summary.cta: Whether I'm designing an ecosystem of intelligent agents or leading the migration of a legacy system to the cloud, my goal remains the same: creating robust technology that empowers decision-making and slashes operational costs.
